This vector activates for common Thai words, syllable fragments, and English loanword prefixes in mixed-script text processing.
These tokens represent Thai vowel signs and tone marks used in the Thai script.
This feature vector activates on sub-word tokens commonly found in Indian and Southeast Asian names, proper nouns, and associated phonetic fragments.
This vector activates strongly for tokens containing the letter 'k' or phonetic equivalents across various scripts.
